title: sframe
description: DRAFT v0.1. Not stable. Schema for a surveyframe .sframe instrument object: a typed research instrument (items, analysis plan, model layer) with a chained five-layer SHA-256 provenance manifest and a derivative citation block. See spec.Rmd for the full specification and the chain algorithm.

sframe_schema_version.description: Version of this schema, independent of the surveyframe package version.

instrument_hash.description: Layer 1 hash. Null until write_sframe() has been called.

layers.description: The five-layer chained provenance manifest. Each present layer's hash is a function of that layer's content plus the previous layer's hash (Merkle-style), seeded from a fixed genesis string at Layer 1. A layer absent here means that lifecycle stage has not occurred yet; the object is still a valid sframe, just not fully citable (see bibliographic.lifecycle_stage).

bibliographic.description: The Derivative Citation Model block. Individual instruments carry no DOI; identity is layers.verification_manifest.hash. The only DOI in any rendered citation belongs to the parent surveyframe package, read from its installed CITATION.cff at render time, not stored here.

lifecycle_stage.description: Count of layers present out of five. Anything short of 5/5 renders as [DRAFT] / NOT FULLY CITABLE.

parent_citation_lock.description: Deterministic key of the parent surveyframe package CITATION.cff entry this instrument is locked to. Required; validation rejects a bibliographic block with no parent lock.

hash.description: SHA-256 of (this layer's content + previous layer's hash), hex-encoded.

previous_hash.description: Null only for the first present layer, which chains from a fixed genesis string instead.
